verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents Fastmail blocking remote images or tracking pixels, by default or otherwise. The only related item is one community remark that Fastmail is 'up front with how the data is handled', which is thin anecdote rather than a documented capability. It does not deliver the core tracking-protection part of the story.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
